name: Met Before
summary: Remembers the players you grouped with and puts your own note about them right into their tooltip.
logoPrompt: A small brass-bound address book lying closed with a quill pen resting across its cover and a ribbon bookmark

cover.tagline: Who you grouped with, and what you thought.
bullets: How often and when you met
Your own note in the tooltip

description: **Met Before keeps track of the players you share a group with and shows you in their tooltip when you met and what you noted about them.**
- Notes every party and raid member: first and last meeting, times grouped and the zone.
- The tooltip of a known player shows how often you met and how long ago.
- Your own short note on a player, shown in the same tooltip.
- A list of the last 10 players you grouped with.
- Shared by all characters of your account.

It starts on its own. Type `/metbefore` for all commands. `/metbefore note Name-Realm text` sets your note, `/metbefore note target text` notes your target, `/metbefore list` shows recent group mates, `/metbefore forget Name-Realm` removes a player.
- Inside instances the game can hide player names from addons, so players there may be skipped and their tooltip stays plain.
- A meeting counts once per group, not on every change.
- The 2000 players met most recently are kept.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
